items.item: The page header has a plural title ("Stock movements") and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 "Stock movements"; one filled blue button "Record movement"; Import and Export are white outlined secondary buttons. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The movements table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (movement type, warehouse, date range) and no decorative hero above it
items.evidence: Table top at 313px (audit firstTableTop), no hero. Search input #q plus visible type tabs (All/Receipts/Issues/Transfers/Adjustments), Warehouse select #fWh and Status button. Date range is behind a "More filters" popover rather than visible inline, a minor deviation.

items.item: Movement type is shown as a text label combined with an icon or shape, not by colour alone, and the set of types is limited to receipt, issue, transfer and adjustment
items.evidence: Type cell renders icon(TYPE_ICON[r.type]) + TYPE1 label; TYPES limited to receipt/issue/transfer/adjustment. Icon choice is weak (adjustment uses a funnel icon, receipt reuses the download arrow) but a text label is always present.

items.item: Quantity changes carry an explicit + or − sign, are right-aligned with tabular figures, and the unit of measure is in the column header or a separate unit column, not repeated inside cells
items.evidence: signedQty() prefixes '+' or '-' (rendered as ASCII hyphen, not a true minus); td class "text-right tabular-nums"; separate "Unit" column. Transfers show an unsigned quantity (161) which is neutral by design. Audit numeric-align flags the Quantity and Value headers as slightly offset from the cell text, because the hidden sort-icon slot adds trailing space.

items.item: A transfer row shows both the source and destination warehouse, and each row has a human-readable document number plus an absolute date and time
items.evidence: whText() returns "Hai Phong Depot → Hanoi DC" for transfers; "Movement no." column shows SM-10538; "Posting date" shows 04/11/2026 16:07 via fmtDate (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm).

items.item: A running balance or resulting on-hand quantity column is available so users can reconcile each movement
items.evidence: COLS has no balance or on-hand column (id, date, type, item, sku, wh, qty, unit, value, status). Neither the detail drawer nor any column toggle exposes resulting stock.

items.item: The table is sorted by date, newest first, by default, with `aria-sort` on the sorted header and pagination at the bottom with a page-size control
items.evidence: DEF.sort='-date'; th gets aria-sort="descending" when cur; first rows run 04/11 16:07 down to 03/11 08:03. #pager has the "Rows per page" select #size (10/25/50), Previous/Next, and "1–10 of 96".

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading skeleton and an error state with retry are also present
items.evidence: !total branch: "No stock movements match …" with #clearF "Clear filters"; !data.length branch: "No stock movements yet" with a Record movement CTA; mode==='loading' renders 8 animate-pulse skeleton rows; mode==='error' shows "Couldn't load stock movements" with #retry.

items.item: Icon-only controls have accessible names, interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: aria-label on bell, account, row-menu ("Actions for movement …"), chip remove, dismiss and close buttons. Audit smallTargets=0 and no text-contrast violations across 159 checked nodes. Row-menu buttons are h-6 w-6 (24px).

notes: Audit score 90, with only the numeric-align header offset flagged. Clean, dense admin look with no template tells: no hero, KPI tiles, gradients, emoji, uppercase tracking or promo card. Main gap is the missing running-balance column. Visual bug in the first-viewport screenshot: the bulk-action bar #bulk has the `hidden` attribute but also the Tailwind `flex` class, so it displays as an empty light-blue strip above the table header when nothing is selected. Minor points: the date range is hidden in the More filters popover; the Quantity and Value headers sit slightly left of their numbers; the Adjustment type icon (funnel) is semantically odd; the sidebar uses a generic box icon for many items.
